title: GUVI: Sort Array by Frequency
description: Given an array of integers `nums`, sort the array in decreasing order based on the frequency of the values. If multiple values have the same frequency, sort them in ascending order of value.
constraints:
1 <= len(nums) <= 10^4
• Time: O(N log N) | Space: O(N)
explanation: Sorting with tuple key (-count, value) achieves frequency ranking with natural value tiebreaking in O(N log N) time.
